verdict.rationale: Codex CLI explicitly recommends signing in with a ChatGPT account (Plus/Pro/Business/Edu/Enterprise) to use Codex without an API key, with API key auth only offered as an alternative requiring extra setup. This matches free/plan-tier access via personal login rather than managing API keys, though evidence doesn't specify a distinct 'free tier' beyond paid ChatGPT plans. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a genuinely free (no-subscription) tier and independent user corroboration of the login flow's simplicity.
